notes:
**Manuscript v0.8.22 highlights:**

- Headings you sized yourself keep their size in the PDF
- A list number follows its first word as you edit
- List numbers match their item's text
- Outdent works on paragraphs indented by a margin
- Colons between numbers survive copying from the PDF
- PDF export no longer drops the end of a paragraph at a page break
- Rejecting a deletion brings back the text's size
- Sections no longer show their text too small or too large
- Turning a quote off keeps the paragraph's own background
- Tracked deletions keep their formatting in Word
